subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks a CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` expose to callers?
rationale: The current behavior can leak text that a plugin blocked or rewrote before transcript persistence, but changing JSON output for blocked writes is a public CLI/result contract decision.

options.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
options.body: Use the post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured suppressed/blocked result without raw text when the hook blocks persistence.

options.title: Thread hook output into JSON only
options.body: Run or thread the same hook result into the JSON builder without re-reading the transcript, but still define blocked-output shape before implementation.

options.title: Keep transcript-only semantics
options.body: Leave `before_message_write` as persistence-only and document that `agent --json` may expose raw CLI output, accepting the security tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
recommendation.body: Use the post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured suppressed/blocked result without raw text when the hook blocks persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook feature and was explicitly pulled into this issue's maintainer timeline for the policy-sensitive follow-up.
